queries.before_change_rows: SELECT CAST(before_change AS TEXT) AS before_change, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM method_change GROUP BY CAST(before_change AS TEXT) ORDER BY before_change;
queries.c_cpp_pair_cardinality: SELECT classification, COUNT(*) AS groups FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(c.before_change='True')=1 AND SUM(c.before_change='False')=1 THEN 'one_to_one' WHEN SUM(c.before_change='True')=0 THEN 'unmatched_after' WHEN SUM(c.before_change='False')=0 THEN 'unmatched_before' WHEN SUM(c.before_change='True')=1 THEN 'one_to_many' WHEN SUM(c.before_change='False')=1 THEN 'many_to_one' ELSE 'many_to_many' END classification FROM candidates c WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(c.signature,''),NULLIF(c.method_name,'')) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.file_change_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(c.signature,''),NULLIF(c.method_name,''))) GROUP BY classification ORDER BY classification;
queries.phase26_logical_groups: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT file_change_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(signature,''))) NOT IN ('','nan','none') THEN TRIM(signature) WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(name,''))) NOT IN ('','nan','none') THEN TRIM(name) ELSE '__unkeyed__:' || method_change_id END AS logical_key FROM method_change GROUP BY file_change_id, logical_key);
queries.phase26_pair_cardinality: WITH grouped AS (SELECT file_change_id, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(signature,''))) NOT IN ('','nan','none') THEN TRIM(signature) WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(name,''))) NOT IN ('','nan','none') THEN TRIM(name) ELSE '__unkeyed__:' || method_change_id END AS logical_key, SUM(CAST(before_change AS TEXT)='True') AS before_rows, SUM(CAST(before_change AS TEXT)='False') AS after_rows FROM method_change GROUP BY file_change_id, logical_key) SELECT CASE WHEN before_rows=1 AND after_rows=1 THEN 'one_to_one' WHEN before_rows=0 THEN 'unmatched_after' WHEN after_rows=0 THEN 'unmatched_before' WHEN before_rows=1 THEN 'one_to_many' WHEN after_rows=1 THEN 'many_to_one' ELSE 'many_to_many' END AS classification, COUNT(*) AS groups, SUM(before_rows) AS before_rows, SUM(after_rows) AS after_rows FROM grouped GROUP BY classification ORDER BY classification;
